telegrams.body: THE STEERING MOTOR OVERHEATED SHORTLY AFTER MIDNIGHT AND THE RESERVE UNIT IS NOW IN USE THE VESSEL IS STEERING SAFELY BUT ARRIVAL WILL BE DELAYED UNTIL ABOUT 1815 PLEASE CONFIRM THAT REPAIRS CAN BE MADE AT THE ANCHORAGE BEFORE WE ENTER

THE ORIGINAL CARGO MANIFEST CONTAINS TWO INCORRECT PACKAGE NUMBERS AND MUST BE REPLACED BEFORE CLEARANCE ALL OTHER ARRIVAL DOCUMENTS HAVE BEEN CHECKED AND ARE READY FOR INSPECTION AT VANCOUVER THE MASTER REQUESTS THAT THE PORT AUTHORITIES ADVISE WHETHER ANY FURTHER DECLARATION IS REQUIRED

THE VESSEL REQUIRES FRESH WATER LUBRICATING OIL AND PROVISIONS AT HONGKONG BEFORE DEPARTURE THE CHIEF ENGINEER WILL CHECK THE QUANTITIES AND CAN BEGIN TAKING BUNKERS AT 2130 THE MASTER REQUESTS THAT THE AGENT CONFIRM THE TOTAL COST AND DELIVERY TIME

WE RECEIVED A DISTRESS CALL FROM A YACHT WHICH HAD LOST ITS MAST IN HEAVY WEATHER OUR RESCUE BOAT HAS PASSED A TOWING LINE AND BOTH VESSELS ARE NOW PROCEEDING SLOWLY PLEASE INFORM THE AUTHORITIES AT VANCOUVER THAT WE EXPECT TO ARRIVE WITH THE TOW AT 1630

WEATHER CONDITIONS HAVE DETERIORATED SINCE MIDNIGHT WITH NORTHEAST WINDS AND FREQUENT RAIN SQUALLS WE HAVE REDUCED SPEED TO EIGHT KNOTS AND MAY ARRIVE SIX HOURS LATE PLEASE CONFIRM THAT SHELTER IS AVAILABLE AT YOKOHAMA IF CONDITIONS CONTINUE TO WORSEN

IT IS NOW EXPECTED THAT WE SHALL REACH MARSEILLE AT 1445 TOMORROW WITH NO FURTHER DELAY THE ENGINES ARE READY FOR MANEUVERING AND BOTH ANCHORS HAVE BEEN CLEARED THE MASTER REQUESTS THAT THE PORT AGENT CONFIRM OUR ASSIGNED BERTH BEFORE 1445
